issues.summary: The bundle-exclusion test is skipped unless RUN_BUNDLE_TESTS is set, and nothing sets it in CI
issues.label: medium
issues.evidence: bundleExclusion.test.ts:32 falls back to describe.skip, and RUN_BUNDLE_TESTS appears nowhere in .github or package.json. The PR description admits this, but it is still the only check that keeps the editor out of production chunks, so a regression would go unnoticed.

issues.summary: No tests cover FeatureFlagEditor or FeatureFlagSection (search filter, reset-all, toggle/revert dispatch, empty section returning null)
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: Only FeatureFlagRow.test.tsx, the hook test and the slice test exist. FeatureFlagEditor.tsx:20-59 and FeatureFlagSection.tsx:15 have no tests. It is a dev-only tool, so the impact is limited.

issues.summary: The editor ignores the config query's loading and error state, so every row shows 'Off' or false while loading or after a failure
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: useFeatureFlagEditorData.ts:32 reads only `data`. At lines 37/41, chains becomes [] and configValue becomes false, so every scope is 'off' and nothing tells the user the load failed. This is real but only affects the dev tool.

issues.summary: Toggling a switch back to the config value keeps a redundant override instead of clearing it
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: FeatureFlagRow.tsx:61 always dispatches setOverride. Toggling twice leaves an override equal to configValue, which still counts in the badge and sits in the Overridden section. This is a minor UX wart, and the match indicator suggests it may be deliberate.

issues.summary: The tabIndex ternary on the revert button is dead code
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: FeatureFlagRow.tsx:85 sits inside the `{isOverridden && ...}` block that starts at line 65, so `isOverridden ? undefined : -1` always evaluates to undefined.

issues.summary: A search with no matches leaves the area blank, with no empty-state message
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: FeatureFlagSection.tsx:15 returns null for empty rows, and FeatureFlagEditor renders no fallback when both filtered lists are empty.

issues.summary: The inline process.env production check is repeated in SafeSidebarContent, where it has no dead-code-elimination reason
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: useChains.ts:13-18 and pages/feature-flags.tsx explain why they need the inline check. The SafeSidebarContent.tsx useMemo check has no such comment, and safeDeveloperGroup is imported statically there anyway, so IS_PRODUCTION would do.

issues.summary: The overrides slice is registered and persisted in production builds too
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: store/index.ts:67 and :95 add the reducer and persistence unconditionally. The code is tiny and applyFeatureOverrides is a no-op in production (useChains.ts:18), so the only cost is a little shipped code and state.

issues.summary: The feature's barrel exports the editor directly and has no contract.ts, feature.ts or createFeatureHandle, which differs from the architecture doc
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: index.ts:1 exports FeatureFlagEditor, while other features such as actions-tray and assets have contract.ts and feature.ts. The page imports it only through a guarded dynamic import, so this is a consistency and documentation issue, not a leak at this commit.

issues.summary: Story titles use 'FeatureFlags/' instead of the 'Features/' prefix
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: Stories under src/features use 'Features/' 62 times. The 3 new stories (FeatureFlagEditor.stories.tsx:10 and others) are the only ones using 'FeatureFlags/'.

issues.summary: The bundle-test marker is banner copy, not a dedicated sentinel
issues.label: low
issues.evidence: bundleExclusion.test.ts:18 matches the Alert text at FeatureFlagEditor.tsx:37. Editing that copy would make the test pass without checking anything, but at present the string appears nowhere else.

issues.summary: A stale overrides entry in localStorage persists in production with no UI to clear it
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: applyFeatureOverrides returns early in production (useChains.ts:18), so a stale entry has no effect. Staging and production also run on different origins, so there is no concrete cost.

issues.summary: The Developer group JSX duplicates the DeFi group block
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: SafeSidebarVariant.tsx:130-144 mirrors the DeFi block. It is a small, readable duplicate with no concrete cost.

issues.summary: The override-count selector subscribes in production
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: The code comment in SafeSidebarContent explains the unconditional hook call (rules of hooks), and the cost is negligible, as the finding itself admits.

issues.summary: The hook test hand-builds chains with a double cast instead of using chainBuilder
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: useFeatureFlagEditorData.test.tsx:9 uses `as unknown as Chain`. chainBuilder exists in tests/builders/chains.ts, but this is only test style.

issues.summary: The config-service column shows the un-overridden value, and a doc comment could say this is intended
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: useFeatureFlagEditorData.ts:32 reads the raw query on purpose so it can compare against config (matchesCurrentChain). A comment would be nice but nothing is wrong.

issues.summary: Suggestion to change how the check icon is labelled for accessibility
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: FeatureFlagRow.tsx:70-77 labels the icon and repeats the text in the tooltip. This is an accessibility preference without a demonstrated failure.

issues.summary: Move long Tailwind class strings and the exported GRID constant into a CSS module
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: The recent commits deliberately restyle the feature with shadcn and Tailwind, so the inline classes at FeatureFlagRow.tsx:19/46 are a style choice.

issues.summary: Components are flat files rather than one folder per component
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: The components/ layout is a style preference, and tests and stories sit next to the files.

issues.summary: The w-12 alignment spacer is a magic value
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: FeatureFlagRow.tsx:58 is a small layout spacer, and the HIDDEN comment covers the alignment intent.

issues.summary: Mixed absolute and relative imports inside the feature
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: FeatureFlagEditor.tsx:7 imports '@/features/feature-flags/store' while other imports in the file are relative. This matches the documented public store import path and is only style.

issues.summary: No test for an override of a feature missing from the Chain features enum
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: The finding itself says the string cast at useChains.ts:20-25 is safe, so the test has no concrete value.

issues.summary: Rename the feature-flags folder
issues.label: nit
issues.evidence: No concrete problem is identified. The cited path features/feature-flag-overrides does not even exist, and 'feature-flags' is descriptive.

issues.summary: Sorting runs on every render
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: useFeatureFlagEditorData.ts:36-59 does the sort inside useMemo keyed on data, overrides and chainId, not on every render. The cost is also trivial.

issues.summary: The claim is that visibility:hidden hides the match indicator from screen readers even when matchesCurrentChain is true
issues.label: wrong
issues.evidence: FeatureFlagRow.tsx:72 applies HIDDEN only when matchesCurrentChain is false. When it is true, style is undefined and the labelled icon is exposed, as the test's toBeVisible assertion confirms.
